script: Something sitting in your bathroom cabinet right now might be more dangerous than you think. In 2023, a company called EzriCare sold something completely ordinary: artificial tears, eye drops for dry eyes. The problem wasn't the drops themselves. It was how they were made - without proper sterility testing, in violation of basic manufacturing rules. A drug-resistant bacteria never before seen anywhere in the United States had gotten into the bottles. Eighty-one people across eighteen states were infected. Some lost an eye entirely. Fourteen people lost their vision. Four people died. From a bottle of eye drops. That outbreak is exactly why regulators started actually checking bottles instead of trusting the label. And it's working. In just the last few months of 2026, millions of bottles from major brands have been pulled from shelves for the same failure. Go check the lot number on whatever's sitting in your bathroom right now. Follow for more true stories that start ordinary and don't stay that way.

In 2023, a company called EzriCare sold something completely ordinary: artificial tears, eye drops for dry eyes.
